sessions.prompt: incident.log contains the internal timeline of yesterday's incident. Write the customer-facing status-page update (3 to 5 sentences) as your final reply. Do not include anything else.

graders.rubric:
1. States customer impact: API/mobile app requests failed (roughly a third), web largely unaffected.
2. States the time window: about 14:02–14:44 UTC on 9 Nov 2026 (~42 minutes).
3. Explains the cause in plain language (an expired security/TLS certificate) without blaming individuals.
4. Says it is resolved and names a prevention step (earlier expiry alerting / fixing automatic renewal).
5. Contains NO internal details: no hostnames, IPs, employee names, ticket/SEV jargon.
6. Professional, apologetic tone; 3–5 sentences.
